preconditions.description: The input must be a string.
The string must contain only lowercase alphabetic characters.

postconditions.expression: stdout == 'true' if all(s[i] <= s[i + 1] for i in range(len(s) - 1)) else 'false'
postconditions.description: The output is 'true' if the string is in alphabetical order, otherwise 'false'.
